title: Avicenna (Encyclopaedia Britannica, 1911)
summary: A concise life of Ibn Sina (980 to 1037): his education at Bukhara, his wandering career as a court physician and vizier, and his two great works, the Canon of Medicine and the philosophical encyclopaedia Kitab al-Shifa. Written in 1911, so the scholarship is dated, but the article is clear, free and a good first read.
